# Archived Pellett & Valbuena input folders

These numbered folders preserve the locations from the source project that the R scripts require. Their names are stable technical paths and must not be renamed.

| Folder | Use in this repository |
|---|---|
| `01_concept/` | Required empty path; no redistributed input is stored here |
| `02_MBH_comb/` | Four inputs used only by the optional workflow: two CSV files containing heterogeneity summaries and two TIFF rasters providing map context |
| `03_corrected_HDR/` | Catalonia inputs shared by the main and optional workflows, plus one raster used only by the optional workflow to provide map context |
| `04_som/` | Required empty path; no redistributed input is stored here |
| `05_review/` | MacArthur inputs shared by the main and optional workflows |

Three empty `.gitkeep` marker files preserve required folder locations in downloaded repository copies. The markers in `01_concept/` and `04_som/` retain otherwise empty required folders. The marker at the root of `02_MBH_comb/` accompanies its included data subfolders and does not mean that the folder is empty.

[`../../INPUT_MANIFEST.csv`](../../INPUT_MANIFEST.csv) lists all 407 input files and records which workflow uses each one. See the [main data guide](../../README.md) for variables, processing, and citations; the [optional workflow guide](../../../PELLETT_VALBUENA_WORKFLOW.md) for the separate optional command; and the [third-party notices](../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for attribution and reuse terms.
